subject: FinLytics POC - success criteria, timeline & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>, Asha Nair <asha@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: FinLytics POC - success criteria, timeline & next steps

Hi Sam / Asha

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have shared expectations for the POC: 

- Primary goal: Validate Redwood's end-to-end latency and cost benefits for FinLytics' real-time insights pipeline (demo dataset + 1 production sample flow).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for 512-token responses on dedicated instance during peak test load
  - Average token cost reduction >= 30% vs current S1 baseline
  - No data exfiltration; audit logs available and accessible to your security team
- Evaluation plan:
  - Week 0: Access & baseline collection (FinLytics provides a representative sample dataset and a dev sandbox)
  - Week 1: Model onboarding + integration (Redwood SE helps with prompts and SDK integration)
  - Week 2: Load test and cost tuning (batching, quantization suggestions)
  - Week 3: Final validation and handoff
- Owners: 
  - FinLytics: provide sample dataset, grant sandbox access (Asha)
  - Redwood SE (Marcus): environment setup, model onboarding, run load tests
  - Redwood AE (Marissa): project coordination, success criteria sign-off, commercial next steps

Next steps: 
1) Asha to confirm sandbox access and share credentials or temporary user by EOD Wednesday (6/3).
2) Marcus and team will provision a dedicated test endpoint once access is received.
3) Marissa will send the POC statement of work / draft agreement (attached) for signature.

Attachments: redwood_poc_agreement_draft.pdf (draft SOW), finlytics_poc-success-criteria.xlsx (proposed metrics).

If this aligns, I'll schedule the kickoff for Thurs 6/4 10:00 PT otherwise propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Nair <asha@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics POC - success criteria, timeline & next steps

Thanks Marissa this looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: can we add an additional item for output quality stability (sample-set pass rate >= 92% on the internal rubric)? Our downstream consumer is sensitive to hallucination spikes during bulk runs.
- Timeline: 6/4 kickoff works for us. We may need to push the heavy load tests to week 2 depending on dataset sanitization speed.
- Access: Asha will share a service account key for sandbox access; she aims to circulate by EOD Wed (6/3).

Action items from FinLytics:
- Asha: share sandbox access + sample dataset (CSV + metadata) target 6/3 EOD
- Sam: coordinate internal stakeholders and prepare a short evaluation rubric (will share by 6/4 kickoff)

We reviewed the draft SOW; legal has a couple of small redlines around data retention and audit log retention windows. I'll send those before the kickoff.

See you on 6/4.

Best,
Sam Walker
Head of ML Engineering | FinLytics
sam.walker@finlytics.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sam Walker <sam.walker@finlytics.com>, Asha Nair <asha@finlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinLytics POC - success criteria, timeline & next steps

Looping in a quick technical checklist so we're ready to go at kickoff: 

1) Access & environment
   - Need service account with read access to sample dataset and ability to run inference in their dev sandbox (Asha).
   - Firewall rules: allow outbound to redwood test endpoint (I'll share IP ranges).
2) Dataset & prompts
   - Provide 200-500 representative prompts and expected outputs (for quality checks).
   - Indicate tokenization expectations (max length) and any special pre/post-processing.
3) Baseline collection
   - FinLytics to send baseline metrics (current avg latency, 95th, cost per token).
4) Load testing plan
   - We'll run a staged load test: 10 rps -> 50 rps -> peak. Need a point-of-contact for on-call during tests (Sam).

I'll prepare a short runbook and a Terraform snippet to provision the test endpoint. If Asha can share access by EOD 6/3 we can have the test endpoint up by EOD 6/4.

Attachments: runbook.md (internal), terraform-snippet.tf (internal) will share links in kickoff.

- Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
